baseline_changes: Only identical examples/cursor_traversal.rs and examples/cursor_traversal/fixture.rs copied into an isolated archive and built with its own target directory. Baseline sources and Cargo files checked against git, and both fixture copies checked byte-for-byte before measurement.
updated_engine: Working-tree streaming single-trail cursors through chained dependent UNWINDs with plain WITH stages. An iterative stack retains one encoded list and frozen input row per active stage; exhausted frames release lists and bindings.
method: Three sequential fresh-process trials per engine, fixture and consumption mode; release builds. Engine order alternates and mode order rotates between trials. All builds/tests finished before measurements. Each process builds a fresh in-memory graph. Query timing includes planning, snapshot setup, decoding, validation and cleanup, excludes fixture setup. First-row latency is time until the first owned row reaches the consumer. Peak RSS and elapsed wall time cover the entire child process, including graph setup.
fixture: A chain with two parallel NEXT relationships per hop. Node-dependent expansion at depth 10 yields 2046 trails and 114686 rows: UNWIND nodes(p), then range(0,node.id). Two scalar ranges at depth 8, fanout 8 yield 510 trails and 32640 rows; depth 1, fanout 256 yields 2 trails and 131072 rows. Inner range bounds depend on the outer member. Plain WITH stages precede, separate and follow expansions. Full consumption checks per-depth multiplicity, both member sums and squared sums, and cross-products. First mode checks one one-hop result. Options allow 1000000 explored states and 1 GiB cumulative payload, retaining default traversal memory limit. Scalar final projections, no path hydration.

queries.unwind-chain-nodes: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH p AS trail,b WHERE b.id >= 1 UNWIND nodes(trail) AS n WITH length(trail) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint,n.id AS source UNWIND range(0,source) AS member WITH hops,endpoint,source,member RETURN hops,endpoint,source,member
queries.unwind-chain: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH length(p) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS source WITH hops,endpoint,source UNWIND range(source,source+$fanout-1) AS member WITH hops,endpoint,source,member RETURN hops,endpoint,source,member
